fusions.name: Seed Arrow
fusions.desc: Looses an arrow that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Seedfall
fusions.desc: Looses 3 arrows at once, spread apart, each dealing 7 damage, and each hit has a 25% chance to leave the target [Caged] for 3 seconds. Your afflictions on a target spread to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Fletching Bed
fusions.desc: Tends a patch of growth 3 tiles across for 10 seconds. You and your allies inside it regain 3 health a second.

fusions.name: Roots Drink
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you regain 3 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
